pr_title: Fix `InputBlockingMod` not always clearing last action on break periods
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/20326

Was an oversight from https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/18017, previously it would only clear if a button was pressed in break, which was a regression to how it was supposed to behave (immediately clear action on break).

issue_context.title: "Alternate" mod doesn't reset after breaks
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

The Alternate mod should reset after a break. This should have been implemented [here](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/18017), but it doesn't seem to work.

### Screenshots or videos


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/55179197/190440551-17b6e9a7-70ac-4672-b1ec-8b69fdfd4975.mp4



### Version

2022.911.0-lazer

review_comments: Not 100% sure about running this every frame, but I guess it's done elsewhere so let's go with it for now and optimise later.

Theoretically it would only happen when a user presses a key (i.e. `LastAcceptedAction != null`), hence why I put that condition first before calling the method.

EDIT: Actually I can see this being bad when in a gameplay period, as the method will keep getting called per-frame until reaching a non-gameplay period, never mind.
